title: Unit 8 L2: I wish / If only
source: Henry's Unit 8 lesson packs (M.3 Communication), Nov 13. American spelling (apologize, not the British -ise).

questions.q: I'm shy and I don't like it. "I wish I ___ so shy."
questions.read_aloud: I wish I wasn't so shy.

questions.q: Last night I shouted at my friend. Now I feel bad. "If only I ___ at her."
questions.read_aloud: If only I hadn't shouted at her.

questions.q: I can't swim, and my friends are going to the pool. "I wish I ___ swim."
Which sentence is about the PAST?
choices: I wish I had more money.
I wish I had studied for the test.
questions.read_aloud: I wish I had studied for the test.

choices: I wish I had a bigger room.
I wish I hadn't told him.
If only I hadn't lost my phone.
questions.read_aloud: I wish I had a bigger room.

questions.q: "I wish I was taller." After I wish, which other word is also correct here?
I didn't study for the exam and I failed. "If only I ___!"
A friend says: "I wish I hadn't eaten so much." How does your friend feel?
questions.read_aloud: I wish I hadn't eaten so much.

questions.q: A friend says: "If only I could play the guitar." Can your friend play the guitar?
questions.read_aloud: If only I could play the guitar.

questions.q: My friend is angry because I forgot her birthday. "I wish I ___ her birthday."
questions.read_aloud: I wish I hadn't forgotten her birthday.
